plan: Given my private value of $6, I aim to bid conservatively to maximize profit. Since I only gain if my value exceeds the third-highest bid, I will bid slightly below my value to avoid overpaying if I win. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their values, so I will bid $5.9 to potentially win with a minimal payment, maximizing my profit if the third-highest bid is lower.

Given my value of $40, my goal is to bid slightly below this to maximize profit while still having a good chance of winning. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their own values, so I will bid $39.9 to outbid those with slightly lower values while ensuring a profit margin if I win. This strategy balances the risk of overbidding against the potential profit from winning.

Given my value of $28, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win while minimizing potential loss. I will bid $26, anticipating that rational bidders will bid close to their values. If both opponents bid higher, I lose nothing. If I win, I pay the third-highest bid, ideally much lower than my value, thus maximizing profit.
